description: This file defines the CustomerDao class, a Data Access Object (DAO) for managing Customer entities within the OrangeHRM time module. It includes methods for retrieving, searching, saving, and deleting customers, as well as handling related projects and associated data.

classes.name: CustomerDao
classes.description: A data access object responsible for interacting with Customer and related entities, providing CRUD operations and complex queries within the OrangeHRM time plugin.

methods.name: getCustomerById
methods.description: Fetches an active customer entity based on the provided ID.

methods.name: getExistingCustomerIds
methods.description: Retrieves existing customer IDs from a given list, filtering out deleted customers.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes customers by IDs after ensuring they do not have associated timesheet entries; employs transaction management.

methods.name: saveCustomer
methods.description: Persists a Customer entity to the database.

methods.name: searchCustomers
methods.description: Returns a list of customers matching search filter parameters, using pagination.

methods.name: getSearchCustomerPaginator
methods.description: Constructs a paginator for customer search queries with filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getSearchCustomersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of customers matching search criteria.

methods.name: isCustomerNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a customer name is already in use, optionally excluding a specific customer ID.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Fetches a customer by ID, regardless of deletion status.

methods.name: getCustomerIdList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer IDs, optionally including deleted customers.

methods.name: getCustomerIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Retrieves customer IDs associated with a specific project admin, optionally including deleted customers.

methods.name: hasCustomerGotTimesheetItems
methods.description: Checks if a customer has associated timesheet items, indicating active work entries.

methods.name: getUnselectableCustomerIds
methods.description: Returns customer IDs linked to existing timesheet entries, implying they cannot be deselected.

methods.name: deleteRelativeProjectsForCustomer
methods.description: Marks as deleted all projects and related entities associated with specified customers.

methods.name: deleteProjects
methods.description: Marks projects as deleted based on project IDs.

methods.name: deleteRelativeProjectActivitiesForProject
methods.description: Marks related project activities as deleted for specified project IDs.

methods.name: deleteRelativeProjectAdminsForProject
methods.description: Deletes project admin records for specific project IDs.
